'''Deelguh''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] active during the early reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He eventually betrayed and left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], becoming a dangerous [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] whom his former [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] partner, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Taradon/Legends|Taradon]], unsuccessfully attempted to bring to justice.

At some point, Deelguh led a force on a [[Raid on Ilum (Deelguh)|raid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in order to acquire the local [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. Taradon engaged Deelguh in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] and, in a last-ditch effort to stop the Rodian, caused a collision between the two [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that [[Death/Legends|killed]] both of them.

==Biography==
Deelguh was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the early period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] existence. At some point, Deelguh [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] together with the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Taradon/Legends|Taradon]]. Deelguh eventually betrayed the Order and became an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and Taradon, who had became a full-fledged [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], spent a long [[Time/Legends|time]] attempting to bring the rogue Jedi to justice. Deelguh kept thwarting his former training partner's attempts, however.<ref name="NoP" />

[[File:Ilum_FDNP.png|thumb|right|250px|Deelguh led a raid on the planet Ilum, in the skies of which he perished.]]
At some point following the Jedi discovery of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]<ref name="NoP" /> around [[22,800 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Deelguh led a force on a [[Raid on Ilum (Deelguh)|raid]] there with the intent of acquiring the local [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] that could be used in Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. As a world that was significant to the Jedi Order, Ilum was protected by Jedi forces, and a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] broke out between the two factions in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]].<ref name="NoP" />

During the conflict, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by Taradon and Deelguh engaged in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|close action]] against each other before entering Ilum's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Deelguh fought off Taradon's attacks and was about to land his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the planet's surface when Taradon, deciding to sacrifice his life in order stop the Rodian's actions, rammed Deelguh's vessel in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] collision. As a result, Deelguh was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Taradon himself, either unable to eject or unwilling to abandon his ship, perished as the burning craft flew down to the surface and crashed.<ref name="NoP" />

==Powers and abilities==
A former member of the Jedi Order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], Deelguh had considerable starship [[Jedi ace|piloting]] skills, being in that aspect the near-equal of the exceptional pilot Taradon. The Rodian was also a fearsome fighter, with Taradon being certain that acquiring the Ilum [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] would lead to the former becoming even more dangerous.<ref name="NoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deelguh was introduced in the [[2016]] sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="NoP" />
